column4: cleat#3903: the test runs every registered backend, and this job's CLEAT_TEST_DB is PostgreSQL-only, so the mysql and mssql subtests skip (two) while the postgres one runs. Measured 2026-11-15 with CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES alone: the skip events are exactly those two names.
same test, same reason, byte-identical regex to the test-go/engine line (cleat#2158's required pairing): the cluster job's CLEAT_TEST_DB gives it Postgres only.

cleat#3903: this job sets only the MySQL DSN, so the postgres and mssql subtests skip (two) and the mysql one runs; measured 2026-11-15 with CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL alone, where the skip events are exactly those two names.

cleat#3903: this job sets only the SQL Server DSN, so the postgres and mysql subtests skip (two) and the mssql one runs; measured 2026-11-15 with CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL alone, where the skip events are exactly those two names.
